no_outcome_promised.note: 'You asked for written confirmation of the payment to your carrier' assumes a payment exists or will be made, which implies an outcome. The note only says the customer requested written confirmation.

no_liability_admitted.note: The apology is for the stress the situation caused and does not concede that the bank was at fault.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Details come from the note. The only timeframe given is the standard 10 business days. The suggestion to keep carrier correspondence is generic.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The note contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the cancellation notice and premium amount, the 9/29 cancellation date, the 9/18 call with no follow-up, the outdated carrier information and the request for written confirmation.

tone.note: Warm, plain and empathetic, and not defensive.

mode_respected.note: Names no department and frames disputed events as the customer's account, including softening the outdated carrier information to 'you were told... may be out of date'.

revision_instructions: Change 'You asked for written confirmation of the payment to your carrier.' to neutral wording that does not assume a payment exists or will be made, e.g. 'You asked us to confirm the position in writing.'
